process_types.description_en: An actor asks for something to be provided or done.
A binary or multi-option decision gate on a submitted request.
Non-binary examination producing comments/changes, not a final decision.
Delivery of a defined service to a requester.
Reactive handling of an unplanned disruption.
Non-linear tracking of a matter with multiple independent work items.
Ensures adherence to an internal policy or external regulation.
Systematic examination producing documented findings.
Acquisition of goods/services from outside the organization.
Movement or control of financial resources.
Tied to an employee's lifecycle.
Lifecycle of a document (draft/review/approve/archive).
One-off, goal-bound activity set, not a repeating template.
Direct interaction with an external customer.
Upkeep of a physical or digital asset.
Periodic examination of an asset/site/condition.
Allocation of time or resources.
Entry of a new entity (employee, customer, vendor) into active status.
Exit of an entity from active status.
Transfer to a higher authority level; usually embedded in another process, rarely standalone.
Deviation handling outside the normal path.
Extension of an expiring commitment/contract.
Qualitative or quantitative evaluation.
Initial recording of an entity into the system.
Operational completion of an accepted request.
